extracted.intended_audience: faculty, researchers, and research administrators preparing grant proposals (Stanford audience)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and submitting research grant proposals, emphasizing that proposals function as detailed work plans and require coordinated budgeting, documentation, and scheduling. Includes pointers to internal/external funding resources and institutional research-development support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal as a work plan
rubrics_metrics.description: A proposal is more than a pitch document; it’s a work plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treat the proposal as a detailed plan of work rather than only persuasive marketing language; structure content to convey tasks, timeline, and deliverables, not just the idea.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand each component of the proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals are complex documents with specific requirements for each section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Make sure you know the purpose and requirements of every section of the solicitation/format so each part meets sponsor expectations and review criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocate adequate time for preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Be sure that you understand each component and allocate adequate time to put together your budget and gather the necessary components for your proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan your timeline early to allow time for budget development, assembling required documents, internal reviews, and any institutional approvals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare a complete and accurate budget
rubrics_metrics.description: Allocate adequate time to put together your budget.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget preparation is a substantive component that requires careful attention; ensure costs align with project tasks and sponsor rules and allow time for institutional review/approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gather all necessary supporting components/documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Gather the necessary components for your proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify and collect required attachments (biosketches, letters, compliance documents, data management plans, etc.) well before the deadline so nothing is missing at submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for additional review steps in the timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep in mind that some components require additional review so that should also be accounted for in your preparation timeline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some items (e.g., human subjects, biosafety, institutional approvals, internal routing) need extra institutional review; build buffer time to accommodate these reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seek general grantsmanship advice
rubrics_metrics.description: Find the most crucial general advice for creating a competitive research proposal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use high-level grantsmanship principles (clarity of aims, significance, feasibility, alignment with sponsor priorities) as you draft and revise; consult available guidance resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check internal funding and limited-submission opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Stanford Seed Funding is a site for faculty to find and apply for internal funding opportunities. A collection of funding opportunities with a limitation in the number of applicants allowed per institution is available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review internal funding programs and limited-submission portals early to identify opportunities and institutional nomination processes and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use external funding resources database
rubrics_metrics.description: Explore a comprehensive Funding Resources Search database of opportunities, awarded grants, and news.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search external funding databases to find sponsor opportunities and examples of awarded grants to inform alignment and competitiveness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult with the Research Development Office (RDO)
rubrics_metrics.description: RDO offers a variety of types of support, depending on the needs of the project, timing, and RD Specialist availability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage RDO for assistance with proposal planning, narrative review, budgeting, and submission strategy; contact them early to match support to project timing and needs.
